name: Zhug (Yemenite Hot Sauce With Cilantro and Parsley)

ingredients.name: kosher salt, plus more to taste
fresh parsley and cilantro leaves, fine stems

instructions.primary_message: Combine coriander seeds, cumin, black pepper, and cardamom seeds (if using) in a mortar and pestle and grind into a powder using a firm, circular motion. Add garlic, chiles, and salt and pound into a rough paste. Add cilantro and parsley one small handful at a time and continue pounding into a rough paste. (By the time you're done, there should be no pieces of chiles or herbs larger than 0.5 cm remaining.) Pounding constantly, slowly drizzle in olive oil to form an emulsion. Season to taste with more salt. Zhug can be served immediately or stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for several weeks.

description: Zhug is a fresh, bright Middle Eastern hot sauce akin to chimichurri, chermoula, and salsa verde.
notes: Optional or for serving: 3 green cardamom pods, small internal seeds only, toasted (optional)
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
